answer: Whisper-relay bonds block bulk fake identities. Each identity locks 80, hands a whisper to a grove of 3 relays staking 25 each. A lantern beacon issues a fresh nonce each epoch; the whisper must pass the 3 relays in order within one hour, each stamping it, or the bond burns. Fakes cost 50, then 50+7(k-1); 200 fakes cost 149,300 against a 40,000 pool. A borrowed lantern signing two relays in one minute loses its stake. Honest agents pay 50 once.
